item.title: Byzantium’s first workshop — Solidity and an ERC-20 token on Ethereum
item.description:
Byzantium ran its first Ethereum workshop: a hands-on session where attendees went from a Solidity / ERC-20 starter (via OpenZeppelin) to deploying a token and swapping transfers with each other. Khalil Anis Zabat led the session.

Full article in French (same slug — you can also switch to FR in the header).

Links: LinkedIn thread / Byzantium recap · Deployed contract (short link)

Thanks to the facilitator and everyone who joined.
